purpose: Append-only audit of the evidence registry after a systematic global review. It separates scale-setting intervals from one-sided floors and validation analogues without lowering the promotion threshold.

active_two_sided_intervals.independence_note: Independent agrarian-output model but geographically shares the England boundary with the scale anchor; grouped holdouts must keep both together.

active_two_sided_intervals.boundary: Continental France / complete EU5 france_region selector
active_two_sided_intervals.independence_note: Restored by append-only supersession; not a new source family.

global_review_conclusions.reason: The source gives village taxes, water rights and crop conditions but no closed population total, no complete cadastral polygon, and no saturation interval. The ~75,000 estimate includes an unresolved urban component.

A demographic reconstruction exists, but the Nile corridor is not equivalent to the EU5 Egypt region and urban redistribution, fiscal under-registration and post-famine timing prevent a defensible saturation interval.
Mapped provincial rice-field/population floors with local food support; no independently measured upper resource limit or saturation fraction. Shared Farris source family.
Closed provincial register and agrarian tax context, but date is outside the target window and the observation is not a demonstrated saturation equilibrium.

global_review_conclusions.candidate: Greater Angkor, Chimor, Hohokam, Upper Mantaro, Lake Titicaca, Tongatapu and Pacific island systems
global_review_conclusions.reason: Archaeological or ecological population envelopes are useful one-sided/held-out tests, but city/tribute concentration, broad dating, model-derived upper bounds, or unresolved saturation prevent two-sided scale promotion.

global_review_conclusions.candidate: Broad African, Yuan Chinese, medieval Indian and Nile continental estimates
global_review_conclusions.reason: No record simultaneously resolves a mapped rural boundary, local-food dependence, census completeness, shock/migration effects and an independent saturation interval. No continental correction is justified.

promotion_threshold_result.remaining_reason: Anchor fit and uncertainty/generalization gates are post-fit decisions; direct frozen-anchor audit still must pass.

method: Reviewed every active packet's boundary, date, population semantics, local-food evidence, pressure evidence, shock/trade caveats and source-family independence. Candidate records remain append-only and rejected records retain explicit reasons. No EU5 starting population, HYDE, RGO identity/modifier or trade-import field was used.
